suites.name: Synthetic Insecure Configuration Suite
suites.description: Evaluates detection of debug flags, wildcard CORS policies, insecure cookie attributes, and hardcoded JWT secrets in application config.

expected_findings.expected: debug: true flag active in sandbox
session_cookie missing http_only and secure flags
Hardcoded synthetic JWT secret key detected

suites.limitations: Synthetic configuration file used for training. Does not modify live production config.

suites.name: Synthetic Secret & Credential Leak Probe
suites.description: Tests pattern recognition and entropy analysis for exposed synthetic AWS keys, database URIs, and webhook endpoints.

expected_findings.expected: Embedded postgresql connection string with credentials

suites.limitations: Tested strings are synthetic dummy values compliant with SIH ethical research constraints.

suites.name: Dependency CVE & Version Intelligence Benchmark
suites.description: Evaluates CVE cross-referencing against pinned legacy software versions known to have published NVD/CVE records.

expected_findings.expected: pyyaml==5.3.1 (Arbitrary Python code execution via FullLoader)

suites.limitations: Static dependency audit without live environment package execution.

suites.name: Localhost HTTP Security Baseline Verification
suites.description: Safe, non-destructive probe verifying basic defensive HTTP headers on the local KAVACH backend API.
suites.limitations: Only queries localhost loopback. Zero destructive fuzzing or denial-of-service.

suites.name: World Monitor: Exact CVE Correlation Benchmark
suites.description: Evaluates deterministic high-confidence correlation when an external CISA/NVD advisory matches the exact CVE referenced in a local finding.
suites.limitations: Evaluates correlation engine logic without initiating outbound network attacks.

suites.name: World Monitor: Technology Defense Overlap Benchmark
suites.description: Evaluates medium-confidence correlation when an external advisory addresses defensive configurations (HSTS/CSP) detected as missing in local URL assessment.

expected_findings.expected: HSTS/CSP defensive overlap correlated with MEDIUM confidence
External context distinguished from local evidence

suites.limitations: Validates that external advisories provide context without fabricating local proof.

suites.name: World Monitor: Unrelated Threat Isolation Benchmark
suites.description: Verifies that unrelated global advisories (e.g. mobile kernel bugs) produce zero false-positive correlations against web targets.

expected_findings.expected: Unrelated mobile kernel advisory produces zero correlation
Unrelated event remains unlinked in situational feed

suites.limitations: Ensures KAVACH does not overclaim correlation on unrelated technologies.

guarantee: Zero active malware, zero weaponized exploits, strictly SIH PS 26163 compliant.
